messages:
maria: Heads-up — proposal to deprecate the internal shim `x-route-snap` and consolidate the telemetry stubs across py/ts/go SDKs. Goal: single compact route header + graceful fallback.
liam: 👍 important we keep quota attribution stable during the roll. any sketches of console impact?
natalie: Console will need a mapping layer for the new compact keys or we'll show a bunch of unknown routes in the per-route tile. Prefer a translation table in the ingest pipeline.
sam: SDK side: plan is to ship fallback behavior so clients send the new header when flagged, but still include legacy header for 6 weeks. canary traffic for the server to learn.
maria: Rollout plan I sketched: 1) behind feature flag enable telemetry stub consolidation server-side; 2) opt-in SDKs emit compact header; 3) server prefers compact header and records mapping; 4) after 6 weeks deprecate shim. start with 5% canary.
liam: Quick example header we're proposing:
```http
X-Redwood-Route: app=payments;route=v2.checkout;shard=eu-west
X-Redwood-Legacy-Route: x-route-snap=abc123 (kept while fallback active)
```
natalie: For the console mapping: suggest sampling the new header at 1% first and run an attribution compare job vs legacy for 48h before toggling fully. that should reveal edge cases.
sam: Action items for SDKs: py/ts can add opt-in flag `compact_route=true` in the next minor; go will release v0.20 with the fallback logic. Add changelog note about legacy header removal timeline.
maria: @liam can you coordinate with quotas team to run a simulated billing run against 2 days of replayed traffic? want to ensure no double-billing or misattribution.
liam: will do. also flag: if both headers are present we must dedupe telemetry events server-side — otherwise metrics double. add a dedupe by header precedence.
natalie: we'll implement server-side precedence: prefer compact header when present, otherwise fall back to legacy shim. will also add a temporary metric `route_header_conflict` to monitor.
deploy-bot: feature-flag-bot: canary rollout started — compact-route flag enabled for 5% of prod traffic (2025-05-14T10:12Z).
sam: timeline: docs PR + SDK patches this week, console mapping and sampling next week, quotas replay the week after, deprecate shim in ~6 weeks.
maria: I'll open the tracking ticket and a short deprecation notice for customers using Private deployments/APIs. also adding a quick devex guide for implementing the fallback in internal proxies.
liam: tiny gotcha — check our edge proxy that strips unknown headers on some managed nodes. might need proxy whitelist update.
natalie: good call. I'll add proxy whitelist to the console mapping ticket.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a short summary + checklist once I open the PRs.
